reviews.review: This is not a bad game just has little to no replayability so id suggest buying it on a sale unless you have a dedicated friend that will play with you

If you're looking for a cool third person shooter, with robot ninjas using magical space powers, this is for you.

But seriously, I've played this game for years, just now clicked that I should probably download it on steam, because why not? I've sunk so much time into this game, it's great.

Pros:
+ Looks great, has done for ages, keeps on getting better, especially for a f2p
+ Not really a pay to win in the sense of 'you have to pay for power gear', apart from asthetics you can earn pretty much earn everything you want, unless you missed an event.
+ Fast paced, good if you're bored of of the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ point 'n click f2p's there are out there.
+ Loads of frames, weapons, mods to choose from, a chance to really combine things for the best results.
+ Watching myself hit criticals at 10k-40k+ never gets boring, trust me. Look forward to end game ♥♥♥♥.

Cons (basically all the same thing):
- Community is alright at best, don't expect too much. Those few who are willing to be leniant to lower levels hang out in the lower level places typically, anywhere past that falls victim to the chat being dead, unless something's going on. 
- Good luck getting into any open raid, people only want people who're either really high level or people who've done it before. They all stay in there own bubble of players
- The trading system sucks major. No lying on that front. Prices for things change in about a day, and ♥♥♥♥'s expensive if it's any good, and you can only really trade decent equipment.
- Build times are kind of irritating, most things take anywhere under a day, with frames taking three days. It can be painful, especially with the new frame taking a total of six days and twelve hours to build.

Playing Warframe is like having a really, REALLY good job. Sure, it's grindy and repetative at times, but you're always working towards a reward, which always affects how you play. Sure, it tempts you constantly with ways to spend real money, but I have never felt the need too. And really, when you boil it down, you play as a robot space ninja with your friends, and not much can beat that, especially when the gameplay's this refined and fun with this many options to chose from.
best game 10/10 if you like ninjas with guns heres your game
